label: Ten club Tarim's triangle
source: Aidan Burns, The New Highgate Collection (2017 expanded PDF), diagram on printed p. 219 / PDF p. 220; accompanying continuation on printed p. 220 / PDF p. 221; compared against The Highgate Collection (2014), printed p. 154 / PDF p. 154. Both diagrams visually checked.
notation: Clockwise siteswap ab9b9b9; starts: Ben at 0, Anne at +1/3 beat, Clare at +2/3 beat. Rows Anne: Ben self Ben; Ben: Anne Clare self; Clare: self Anne self. Single passes; Clare's passes to Anne are crossing.
visualVerification: Compared the complete arrow diagrams, hand labels and action rows in 2017 printed p. 219 (with action text continued on printed p. 220) and 2014 printed p. 154. The arrows establish Anne→Ben at the second subsequent event, Anne self to her next event; Ben→Anne at the next lane event, Ben→Clare at the next lane event (phase-shifted by 2/3 beat), Ben self to his next event; Clare self to her next event, Clare→Anne two lane events later, Clare self to her next event. The three-action rows repeat over a six-beat hand cycle.
modelLimitations: The graph records causal endpoints and cycle wraps. It does not separately encode the printed straight/crossing trajectory, initial club inventory, or siteswap direction.
